_meta.note: Maps HIG components to SwiftUI. Stable APIs (Button, NavigationStack, TabView, List) are confident. Liquid Glass names below were checked on 2026-10-17 against Apple's SwiftUI docs for OS 26 (shipping) and the OS 27 betas: all still present, none deprecated. APIs marked 27.0+ are beta-era: names can still change before release, so confirm in Xcode before shipping.
_meta.liquid_glass_api: All 26.0+. .glassEffect(_:in:) takes a Glass value: .regular (default), .clear (over media, with a dimming layer) or .identity (no effect); chain .interactive() for touch response and .tint(Color) for colored glass. Wrap multiple glass shapes in GlassEffectContainer to merge/morph them; .glassEffectID(_:in:) animates between them, .glassEffectUnion(id:namespace:) joins shapes into one, .glassEffectTransition(_:) picks .matchedGeometry or .materialize. Related: .scrollEdgeEffectStyle(_:for:), .backgroundExtensionEffect(), ToolbarSpacer. Confirm exact signatures in Xcode.
_meta.verify_against: current Xcode SDK + HIG component page

liquid_glass_style.name: .buttonStyle(.glass) (secondary) | .buttonStyle(.glass(.clear)) (over media) | .buttonStyle(.glassProminent) (primary); custom views: .glassEffect(_:in:)
liquid_glass_style.note: 26.0+. Tint only the one primary action (e.g. Done); a toolbar where every button is tinted is the HIG's own wrong example.

os27_beta.note: 27.0+ (beta, names may change): .toolbarMinimizationBehavior(.onScrollDown, for: .navigationBar); ToolbarItem placement .topBarPinnedTrailing; .visibilityPriority(_:) and ToolbarOverflowMenu for overflow.

liquid_glass.note: Liquid Glass is applied to TabView automatically from iOS 26 (plus scroll-edge effects); use .tabBarMinimizeBehavior(_:) (26.0+, not deprecated in 27) to control minimize-on-scroll. 27.0+ (beta): Tab(role: .prominent) puts one tab in a separate trailing spot, and .toolbarMinimizationBehavior(_:for: .navigationBar) also minimizes an integrated top tab bar.

slider.note: Apple publishes no track/thumb metrics; the thumb and its row honor the 44pt hit target. Tint the active track with .tint — there is no dedicated 'progress' semantic color role.

progress.note: No dedicated 'progress' semantic color — tint the bar with a system color via .tint.
